truths.statement: tests/test_streaming.py uses ephemeral-port HTTP servers to prove the first downstream SSE delta arrives before a controlled upstream completion barrier is released.

Streaming regressions cover real server /api/chat SSE headers, upstream stream:true payloads, auth/origin rejection before upstream contact, invalid input, malformed upstream frames and sanitized upstream error frames.
Security regressions cover production Secure-cookie override hardening, unsupported Transfer-Encoding rejection, invalid Content-Length rejection and connection-close behavior after framing errors.
Required validation runners passed: project-tests reported 117 passed and 0 failed; web-syntax reported Web source syntax and top-level symbols passed.

dont_assume: An incidental socket reset traceback during the connection-close regression is not a test failure when project-tests exits 0.
